name: Hana Microelectronics Public Company Limited
summary: Hana Microelectronics Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and trading of electronic components. The company provides printed circuit board assemblies, chip-on-board and flex assembly and test, lamination, coil, winding, integrated circuit assemblies and tests, and LED packaging and test services. It also offers electronics manufacturing, and outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing services IC, MEMS, sensors, TO Can, system in packages, optocouplers, and SMT.
